description: Free. Fetch /.well-known/agents.json — the ML-DSA-65-SIGNED index of agents whose latest fractalai-agent-manifest/1 is CURRENT (key equals the agent's current key on the FractalAI node, passport verifies, FRC-55 status Active, not expired) — and verify the index signature OFFLINE against the notary key PINNED in this package (never a key the server hands over). An index whose signature does not verify, that is expired (expires_at), or that is OLDER (issued_at/seq) than one already accepted in this process is returned as an ERROR with no agents. Returns { index_signature_verified: true, signer_kid, issued_at, expires_at, seq, scope, registry { identity_root, height }, agents[] { id, name, did, manifest_url, manifest_id, version, kid, status } }. Set include_all to also list non-current agents (rotated key, paused, expired) from /api/agents/registry?status=all with their reasons. Set region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. CO) to fetch the SEPARATELY signed regional index (?region=CO: only current agents whose manifest declares that country); the signed scope.region MUST equal the request — a global index re-served for a regional request is an ERROR index_scope_mismatch, never a fallback; a valid region with no agents is a signed empty list; an unlisted code is the server's 400 region_invalid. Prices are never listed: the binding price is each resource's live 402.

include_all.description: Also return non-current agents with the reasons they are not current.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (uppercase). Fetches the regional index and requires scope.region to match.

name: list_agents
title: List FractalAI Agent Commons agents (signed index)
